subject: Implement weighted activation search engine
description: Add a pure weighted graph activation module for Zonoid search. Scope: create lib/search/activation.js and focused tests. Use existing judged context adjacency ideas from lib/judge.js where practical, but keep this module pure and independent of /search routing. Inputs should include seed nodes, adjacency, maxDepth, decay, relation/edge weights, confidence, and budget. Output ranked activated nodes with provenance/path/depth/activation. Verify weight-0/unjudged edges do not activate, activation decays over hops, and a semantically weak but strongly wired neighbor can surface. Do not modify routes/graph.js in this task.
